description: The file contains the implementation of the CohortService interface, specifically the CohortServiceImpl class, which provides various methods for managing cohort entities and their memberships within the OpenMRS healthcare system. It includes functions for creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and voiding cohorts and cohort memberships, as well as handling patient associations with cohorts.

classes.name: CohortServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class implementing CohortService that manages cohort and cohort membership operations, including creation, retrieval, update, deletion, voiding, and handling patient membership within cohorts.

methods.name: setCohortDAO
methods.description: Sets the Data Access Object for cohort operations.

methods.name: saveCohort
methods.description: Saves a cohort, with privilege checks and validation.

methods.name: getCohort
methods.description: Retrieves a cohort by its ID.

methods.name: voidCohort
methods.description: Marks a cohort as voided or inactivated.

methods.name: getCohortByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a cohort by its UUID.

methods.name: getCohortMembershipByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a cohort membership by its UUID.

methods.name: addPatientToCohort
methods.description: Adds a patient to a specific cohort if not already a member.

methods.name: removePatientFromCohort
methods.description: Removes a patient from a cohort by voiding their membership.

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatient
methods.description: Returns a list of cohorts containing a specific patient.

methods.name: getCohortsContainingPatientId
methods.description: Returns a list of cohorts containing a patient by their ID.

methods.name: getCohorts
methods.description: Retrieves cohorts matching a name fragment.

methods.name: getAllCohorts
methods.description: Retrieves all cohorts; optionally including voided ones.

methods.name: getAllCohorts
methods.description: Overloaded method to retrieve all cohorts with optional inclusion of voided cohorts.

methods.name: getCohortByName
methods.description: Fetches a cohort by its exact name.

methods.name: purgeCohort
methods.description: Deletes a cohort from the system.

methods.name: purgeCohortMembership
methods.description: Removes a cohort membership from the system.

methods.name: voidCohortMembership
methods.description: Marks a cohort membership as voided.

methods.name: endCohortMembership
methods.description: Sets an end date for a cohort membership.

methods.name: notifyPatientVoided
methods.description: Updates cohort memberships when a patient is voided.

methods.name: notifyPatientUnvoided
methods.description: Restores cohort memberships when a patient unvoids.

methods.name: getCohortMemberships
methods.description: Fetches cohort memberships for a given patient, date, and voided status.
